title: Regularity and projectivity of a point blowup on a regular surface
statement: Let $X$ be an integral regular excellent Noetherian scheme of dimension $2$ admitting an ample invertible sheaf. Let $p\in X$ be closed with $\dim\mathcal O_{X,p}=2$, and let $b:X'=\operatorname{Bl}_pX\to X$ be the blowup of the reduced closed point. Then $X'$ is integral regular excellent Noetherian of dimension $2$ and admits an ample invertible sheaf. The morphism $b$ is of finite type and projective in the finite-projective-space convention. Its exceptional divisor $E=b^{-1}(p)$ is isomorphic to $\mathbf P^1_{\kappa(p)}$ and is regular. For any closed subscheme $W\subseteq X$ containing $p$, the support of $W\times_XX'$ is the union of $E$ and the support of the strict transform of $W$. For any integral closed subscheme $Y\subseteq X$, its strict transform is the blowup of $Y$ in $p\times_XY$. Conventions: [def-pc-integral-scheme], [def-weil-regular-scheme], [def-exc-excellent-ring], [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring], [def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module], [def-nagata-global-blowup], [def-weil-closed-immersion], [def-nagata-strict-transform], [def-kun-projective], [def-weil-finite-type-morphism], [def-nagata-projective-space-base-change], [def-weil-residue-field], [def-pc-fibre-product].
